name: Bullet and Black Magic
body:
You have sought out spells to enhance your guns and cut down your foes with dark power.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, grit class feature, ability to cast 1st-level antipaladin spells

Benefit(s): Add the following spells to your antipaladin spell list at the indicated levels: 1st-stabilize powder, 2nd-ricochet shot, 3rd-quieting weapons, 4th-greater named bullet.

The Antipaladin’s Almanac, © 2020, Librarians & Leviathans.
